lines.text: Ish-bosheth questions Abner about Saul's concubine Rizpah, and Abner becomes furious over the accusation.
Abner swears to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and establish David's throne from Dan to Beersheba.
Abner asks David to make a sacrifice with him, and David requires him to bring Saul's daughter Michal.
Ish-bosheth takes Michal from her husband Paltiel, who follows her weeping to Hebron until Abner tells him to go back.
Abner comes to David at Hebron with twenty men, David holds a feast, and Abner leaves in peace.
